resources student groups equipment loaning production guide funds & grants the heartbeat of student creativity. nussu council funding this funding scheme is geared towards students’ interests in spearheading their own initiatives, and in doing so, it encourages a spirit of community vibrancy and dynamism. apply now usparks grant the u-sparks funding grant aims to a promote sporting lifestyle, arts appreciation and cultural understanding among the nus community and external communities. apply now nus performing and visual arts scholarship (mid-term) the nus performing & visual arts scholarship is awarded to highly-talented individuals who possess outstanding academic, performing and/or visual arts participation and representation records. apply now cac creator grant the cac creators’ grant is an initiative by the nus cultural activities club (cac) designed to support full-time nus undergraduates in executing self-led arts or cultural projects. apply now nussu space credits funding this funding scheme bolsters nus student groups organizing student-led activities and enhance student life on campus. this initiative is designed ito alleviate the operational expenses of student groups and encourage the optimal use of nus facilities. apply now apply now national arts council (nac) funding the nac provides a sustainable funding infrastructure through grants and arts housing support for the arts community to achieve a vision of singapore as home to diverse and distinctive arts that inspire our people, connect our communities and position singapore globally. nussu adobe creative cloud licensing scheme the nus students' union (nussu) offers a limited monthly adobe creative cloud licensing scheme to all general undergraduates, allowing access to desktop content: this website is under development. check in again on 4 october 2026. about venue funding publicity resources student groups equipment loaning production guide about venue funding publicity resources student groups equipment loaning production guide publicity resources make your voices heard. digital & social media channels nussu platforms channels included: telegram channel, electronic digital mailer (edm), instagram story repost, and general noticeboard. for queries, email nussu.communicationssec@u.nus.edu . apply now 3 days before publication apply now osay! e-newsletter artwork requirements: image must be exactly 600 × 400 pixels (px) . for queries, email osay@nus.edu.sg . nus arts & cfa channels nus arts on campus telegram group: arts events on campus or open calls for participants. nus cfa instagram: instagram content for relevant arts promotion. digital noticeboard (com3): available for digital display. 2 weeks before promotion setting up official portal events (nusync) if you want to invite all students to join your student-body-led activities (on or off campus), you should host them on: nusync event creation guide important: after saving, your group may need to submit additional information to campus administrators and await final approval before the event goes live. for technical help, view the: physical campus media workflow the physical poster approval checklist for inquiries, email osastudentleadership@nus.edu.sg and review the campus responsible poster usage guidelines. on-campus outdoor banners banner spaces are managed entirely by their respective venue owners. write directly to the specific venue owners to inquire about availability, and make sure to include all of your organization's contact details in the email. resources student groups equipment loaning production guide equipment loaning find the tools to pursue your dreams. nus amplified upon request, can provide instruments and a variety of sound equipment such as mixers, di boxes and cables, etc. for more information, please refer to the excel attached below. to loan equipment, please contact nus amplified at nusamplified@gmail.com nus arts production crew upon request, can provide instruments, sound equipment and lighting equipment. beyond the loaning of equipment, nus arts production crew also provides crewing services. listed is the terms and conditions for equipment and/or crew rental: equipment list email to loan equipment list email to loan terms of loan the loan period will commence and terminate on the dates agreed upon. any and all extensions of the loan period are subject to written agreement between nus arts production crew and the lending group. the lending group will ensure that the equipment received on the commencement date of the loan period is in satisfactory working equipment. the lending group is to return all equipment to nus arts production crew on the termination date in the same condition it was loaned out. the lending group is liable for any and all damages to the equipment during the loan period. in the event of loss, theft, or damage of any equipment, the lending group will immediately inform nus arts production crew. the lending group will be liable for the full cost of repair of any damaged equipment. the lending group will replace any equipment that is lost, stolen, or damaged beyond repair with an item that is identical or equivalent in value and kind. a fine of $2 per day per piece of equipment will be imposed for late returns. full payment to nus arts production crew will be made one week after the termination date. to loan equipment, please contact nus arts production crew at nusartsproductioncrew@gmail.com reach us info.nuscac@gmail.com where we are nus students' cultural activities
